en.s: The Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland took place during the late 12th century, when Anglo-Normans and Cambro-Normans gradually conquered and acquired large swathes of land in Ireland over which the monarchs of England then claimed sovereignty. The Anglo-Normans claimed the invasion was sanctioned by the papal bull Laudabiliter. Gaelic Ireland then consisted of several kingdoms, with a High King claiming lordship over most of the other kings.
en.n: Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland: The Kingdom of Dublin falls to Anglo-Norman invaders.

zh.t: 盎格鲁-诺曼人入侵爱尔兰
zh.s: 12世纪后期，盎格鲁-诺曼人和坎布罗-诺曼人逐步征服并夺取爱尔兰大片土地，英格兰君主随后声称对这些土地拥有主权，这一过程构成了盎格鲁-诺曼人入侵爱尔兰。盎格鲁-诺曼人声称，这场入侵得到教皇诏书《Laudabiliter》的授权。当时的盖尔爱尔兰由多个王国组成，一位至高王声称对其他大多数国王拥有宗主权。
zh.n: 盎格鲁-诺曼人入侵爱尔兰：都柏林王国被盎格鲁-诺曼入侵者攻陷。

en.s: The Conquest of Cuenca was the siege of the city of Cuenca led by Alfonso VIII of Castile and Alfonso II of Aragon in 1177. The siege lasted for over nine months until the city was surrendered by the Almohads on 21 September.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1177年，卡斯蒂利亚国王阿方索八世和阿拉贡国王阿方索二世率军围攻昆卡。围城持续九个多月，直至9月21日，城池由阿尔摩哈德王朝守军交出。

en.s: (For the 20th century battle in Belfast, see Battle of St. Matthews.) The Battle of Matthew's Day (Estonian: Madisepäeva lahing) was fought near Viljandi (probably in Vanamõisa) on September 21, 1217 during the Livonian Crusade. The adversaries were the German crusading order the Sword Brethren with their recently converted Livonian and Latgalian allies and an army of 6000 Estonian men from different counties, led by Lembitu, who had attempted to unify the Estonians. The Germans won, Lembitu and Caupo of Turaida (converted Livonian chieftain, fought on the order's side) were killed. Also many others were forced to convert.

zh.s: 圣马太日战役（爱沙尼亚语：Madisepäeva lahing）于1217年9月21日在维尔扬迪附近（可能在瓦纳莫伊萨）爆发，属于利沃尼亚十字军东征的一部分。（关于20世纪贝尔法斯特的战役，见“圣马修战役”。）交战一方是宝剑骑士团及其刚刚皈依基督教的利沃尼亚和拉特加尔盟友；另一方是来自不同地区、由试图统一爱沙尼亚人的伦比图率领的6000名爱沙尼亚人。德意志一方获胜，伦比图和图赖达的考波——一位已皈依基督教、站在骑士团一方作战的利沃尼亚酋长——阵亡。许多其他人也被迫皈依。

en.t: Livonian Crusade: The Estonian leader Lembitu and Livonian leader Caupo of Turaida are killed in the Battle of St. Matthew's Day
en.s: The Livonian crusade consisted of the various military Christianisation campaigns in medieval Livonia – modern Latvia and Estonia – during the Papal-sanctioned Northern Crusades in the 12th–13th century.

zh.t: 利沃尼亚十字军东征：爱沙尼亚领袖伦比图和利沃尼亚领袖考波在圣马太日战役中阵亡
zh.s: 利沃尼亚十字军东征包括12至13世纪中叶在利沃尼亚（今拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚）展开的多场军事基督教化行动，属于教宗授权的北方十字军东征。

en.s: The Battle of Hiltersried took place on 21 September 1433 near the village Hiltersried in Bavaria. A Bavarian feudal army under Count Palatine John of Neumarkt took an expedition against in the Upper Palatinate against marauding Hussites and soundly defeated the Hussite section whose task was to ensure the protection for troops besieging Pilsen. The Hussites, who on that day were not expecting any attack, were totally surprised and did not have time to prepare to defend. After a sharp firing crossbows, the mounted knights attacked in wedge formation toward the entrance to the camp.

zh.s: 希尔特斯里德战役于1433年9月21日在巴伐利亚希尔特斯里德村附近爆发。新马克特伯爵、普法尔茨选侯约翰率领巴伐利亚封建军队出征上普法尔茨，讨伐四处劫掠的胡斯派，并大败了其中一支负责保护围攻比尔森部队的队伍。胡斯派当天没料到会遭到袭击，完全措手不及，无暇组织防御。弩箭猛烈齐射后，骑士们列成楔形阵，向营地入口发起冲锋。

en.s: The Congress of Arras was a diplomatic congregation established at Arras in the summer of 1435 during the Hundred Years' War, between representatives of England, France and Burgundy. It was the first negotiation since the Treaty of Troyes and replaced the fifteen-year agreement between Burgundy and England that would have seen the dynasty of Henry V inherit the French crown.

zh.s: 阿拉斯会议于1435年夏季在阿拉斯举行，是百年战争期间英格兰、法国和勃艮第代表参加的一次外交会议。这是《特鲁瓦条约》签订后的首次谈判，并取代了勃艮第与英格兰之间为期15年的协议；该协议原定由亨利五世王朝继承法国王位。

en.s: The siege of Maribor was a siege of present-day Maribor, then known by its German name Marburg, in the Duchy of Styria within the Archduchy of Austria and the Holy Roman Empire. In the siege that happened during September 1532, a local garrison and citizens defended the fortified town of Maribor against the overwhelming force of the Ottoman Empire, led by their Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent and his Grand Vizier Pargalı Ibrahim Pasha.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1532年9月，奥斯曼帝国苏丹苏莱曼大帝及大维齐尔帕尔加勒·易卜拉欣帕夏率领大军围攻马里博尔。当时马里博尔位于奥地利大公国和神圣罗马帝国境内的施蒂里亚公国，如今属于斯洛文尼亚。当地驻军和市民守卫这座设防城镇，抵挡奥斯曼军队。

en.s: The Battle of Placentia (1692) was fought between the English and the French at Fort St. Louis (Castle Hill) in Placentia, Newfoundland and Labrador during King William's War. The battle lasted from 16 September until 21 September 1692.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 威廉王之战期间，英国和法国军队在纽芬兰与拉布拉多省普拉森西亚的圣路易斯堡（城堡山）交战。战斗从1692年9月16日持续到9月21日。

en.s: The Battle of Lugos was fought on 21 September 1695 near the city of Lugos in the East Banat, between the forces of the Ottoman Empire and the forces of the Habsburg monarchy as part of the Great Turkish War.

zh.s: 1695年9月21日，大土耳其战争期间，奥斯曼帝国军队与哈布斯堡君主国军队在东巴纳特的卢戈什城附近交战。

en.s: The Battle of El Albujón was a confrontation between Bourbon troops under commandante Patricio Moran and corporal José Hernández and an English force backed by troops loyal to Charles VI. It took place on 21 September 1706 and formed part of the War of the Spanish Succession. It took part in the El Albujón district of the Spanish town of Cartagena and ended in a Bourbon victory.

zh.s: 1706年9月21日，西班牙王位继承战争期间，布尔波恩王朝军队与一支由支持查理六世的部队协助的英格兰军队在西班牙卡塔赫纳的埃尔阿尔布洪区交战。布尔波恩军队由帕特里西奥·莫兰指挥官和下士何塞·埃尔南德斯率领，最终获胜。

en.s: The Capture of Minorca saw the island of Menorca captured from Spain by British and Dutch forces acting on behalf of Charles VI, Holy Roman Emperor - the Austrian claimant to the Spanish throne - in September 1708 during the War of the Spanish Succession. The British would later annex the island as their own possession at the Treaty of Utrecht (1713).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 西班牙王位继承战争期间，英国和荷兰军队代表神圣罗马帝国皇帝、奥地利王位继承人查理六世，于1708年9月从西班牙手中夺取梅诺卡岛。英国后来在1713年《乌得勒支条约》签订后将该岛并为己有。

en.s: The Battle of Prestonpans was the first significant conflict in the Jacobite Rising of 1745. The battle took place at 4 am on 21 September 1745. The Jacobite army loyal to James Francis Edward Stuart and led by his son Charles Edward Stuart defeated the government army loyal to the Hanoverian George II led by Sir John Cope. The inexperienced government troops were outflanked and broke in the face of a highland charge. The victory was a huge morale boost for the Jacobites, and a heavily mythologised version of the story entered art and legend.

zh.s: 普雷斯顿潘斯战役是1745年詹姆斯党起义中的首场重要冲突。战役于1745年9月21日凌晨4点打响。效忠詹姆斯·弗朗西斯·爱德华·斯图亚特的詹姆斯党军队由其子查尔斯·爱德华·斯图亚特率领，击败了效忠汉诺威王朝乔治二世的政府军；政府军由约翰·科普爵士指挥。缺乏经验的政府军遭到侧翼包抄，在高地冲锋面前溃败。此役大大提振了詹姆斯党人的士气，后来这场战役的故事也被艺术和传说大幅渲染。

en.t: Part of New York City is burned shortly after being occupied by British forces
en.s: New York, often called New York City (NYC), is the most populous city in the United States. It is located at the southern tip of New York State on New York Harbor, one of the world's largest natural harbors. The city comprises five boroughs—Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island—each being coextensive with its respective county.

zh.t: 英军占领纽约市后不久，纽约部分地区发生火灾
zh.s: 纽约市常简称纽约，是美国人口最多的城市，位于纽约州南端的纽约港畔。纽约港是世界上最大的天然港口之一。该市由曼哈顿、布鲁克林、皇后区、布朗克斯和史泰登岛五个行政区组成，各区范围分别与对应郡县一致。

en.s: The Great Fire of New York burned through the night of September 20, 1776, and into the morning of September 21, on the West Side of what then constituted New York City at the southern end of the island of Manhattan. It broke out in the early days of the military occupation of the city by British forces during the American Revolutionary War.

zh.s: 1776年9月20日夜间至21日早晨，纽约市曼哈顿岛南端、当时城市西侧发生大火。火灾发生在美国独立战争期间英军占领纽约初期。

en.s: The Battle of Wahab's Plantation was a surprise attack on a Loyalist camp, which included elements of the British Legion commanded by Banastre Tarleton (although at the time of the battle Tarleton had yellow fever and was not in command), by Patriot militia under the command of William R. Davie on September 21, 1780. The owner of the plantation was militia Captain James A. Walkup who served as a guide for Davie prior to the attack. Confusion has arisen over the spelling of the name Wahab as there are many spellings of the surname including, Walkup/Wahab/Wauchope/Waughup.

zh.s: 1780年9月21日，爱国者民兵在威廉·R·戴维指挥下，突袭了一处效忠派营地。营地中有班纳斯特·塔尔顿指挥的英国军团部分部队，但塔尔顿当时患黄热病，并未指挥这场战斗。种植园主人詹姆斯·A·沃尔克普是民兵上尉，曾在袭击前为戴维带路。由于沃哈布这个姓氏有多种拼法，包括Walkup、Wahab、Wauchope和Waughup，因此战役名称的拼写也存在混乱。

en.s: The National Convention (French: Convention nationale, [kɔ̃vɑ̃sjɔ̃ nɑsjɔnal]) was the constituent assembly of the Kingdom of France for one day and of the French First Republic for its first three years during the French Revolution, following the two-year National Constituent Assembly and the one-year Legislative Assembly. The National Convention was created after the insurrection of 10 August 1792.
en.n: French Revolution: The National Convention abolishes the monarchy.

zh.t: 法国国民公会废除君主制
zh.s: 国民公会（法语：Convention nationale）在法国大革命期间先作为法兰西王国的制宪议会存在一天，随后成为法兰西第一共和国的立法机构，持续三年。它继两年制宪国民议会和一年立法议会之后成立。国民公会是在1792年8月10日巴黎起义后成立的。
zh.n: 法国大革命：国民公会废除君主制。

en.s: The Battle of Montaigu was a battle on 21 September 1793 during the War in the Vendée, in which the Vendéens attacked general Jean-Michel Beysser's French Republican division. Taken by surprise, this division fought back but lost 400 men, including many captured. Some of these prisoners were summarily executed by the Vendeens and their bodies later found in the castle wells by troops under Jean-Baptiste Kléber. Following this battle Beysser was recalled to Paris, compromised by his Girondin past and condemned to death with the Hébertists on 13 April 1794.

zh.s: 蒙泰居战役于1793年9月21日在旺代战争期间爆发，旺代军袭击了让-米歇尔·贝塞尔将军的法国共和军师。共和军猝不及防，虽奋力反击，仍损失400人，其中许多人被俘。一些俘虏遭旺代军就地处决；后来，让-巴蒂斯特·克莱贝尔将军的部队在城堡的井中发现了他们的遗体。战后，贝塞尔被召回巴黎；由于他有吉伦特派背景，后来与埃贝尔派人士一同被判处死刑，时间是1794年4月13日。

en.s: The Battle of Dego took place in present-day Italy during the War of the First Coalition between French and Austrian armies on 21 September 1794. It resulted in a French victory. The battle was described in Napoleon's correspondence, having been present.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争期间，法国与奥地利军队于1794年9月21日在今意大利境内进行代戈战役，最终法军获胜。拿破仑当时在场，并在自己的通信中提到这场战役。

en.s: The Battle of the Diamond was a planned confrontation between the Catholic Defenders and the Protestant Peep o' Day Boys that took place on 21 September 1795 near Loughgall, County Armagh, Ireland. The Peep o' Day Boys were the victors, killing some 30 Defenders, with no casualties in return. It led to the foundation of the Orange Order and the onset of "the Armagh outrages".

zh.s: 钻石战役是天主教保卫者与新教“晨日男孩”之间一场有计划的冲突，于1795年9月21日在爱尔兰阿马郡洛夫戈尔附近爆发。“晨日男孩”获胜，杀死约30名保卫者，己方无人伤亡。此役促成了奥兰治会的成立，也引发了“阿马暴行”。

en.s: The raid on Saint-Paul was an amphibious operation conducted by British forces against the port of Saint-Paul in the French colony of Isle Bonaparte during the Napoleonic Wars. It was launched on 20 September 1809 as both a precursor to a future full-scale invasion of Isle Bonaparte and in order to capture the French frigate Caroline and the East Indiamen she had seized in the action of 31 May 1809 which were sheltering in the harbour.

zh.s: 圣保罗突袭是拿破仑战争期间英国军队对法属波拿巴岛圣保罗港实施的一次两栖行动。行动于1809年9月20日发起，既为日后全面入侵波拿巴岛作准备，也旨在夺取法国护卫舰“卡罗琳”号及其于1809年5月31日海战中截获、正停泊在港内的东印度商船。

en.s: The Raid on Gananoque was an action conducted by the United States Army on 21 September 1812 against Gananoque, Upper Canada during the War of 1812. The Americans sought to plunder ammunition and stores to resupply their own forces. Gananoque was a key point in the supply chain between Montreal and Kingston, the main base of the Provincial Marine on the Great Lakes.

zh.s: 1812年战争期间，美国陆军于1812年9月21日袭击上加拿大的加纳诺克，企图掠夺弹药和军需物资，为己方部队补给。加纳诺克是蒙特利尔至金斯顿补给线上的重要地点；金斯顿是五大湖地区省级海军的主要基地。

en.s: The siege of Fort Erie, also known as the Battle of Erie, from 4 August to 21 September 1814, was one of the last engagements of the War of 1812, between British and American forces. It took place during the Niagara campaign, and the Americans successfully defended Fort Erie against a British army under Gordon Drummond.
en.n: War of 1812: British forces abandon their unsuccessful siege of Fort Erie.

zh.s: 伊利堡围城战（又称伊利战役）发生于1814年8月4日至9月21日，是1812年战争后期英国与美国之间的一场战斗，属于尼亚加拉战役的一部分。美军成功守住伊利堡，抵挡了戈登·德拉蒙德率领的英军。
zh.n: 此条目记录的是1814年9月21日英军放弃围城的事件。

en.s: The ambush at Mount Kelir took part on 21 September 1829 during the closing stages of the Java War, at the foot of Mount Kelir in Kulon Progo. High-ranking rebel commander Jayakusuma I was killed during the encounter. Prince Jayakusuma I, one of the senior commanders of Javanese rebels under Diponegoro, along with two of his sons and twenty cavalrymen, was ambushed by a larger force of native troops fighting under the Dutch, consisting of Javanese and Manadonese soldiers led by Javanese officer Raden Ngabehi Resodiwiryo (later known as Cokronegoro I).

zh.s: 1829年9月21日，爪哇战争接近尾声时，凯利尔山脚下发生伏击。迪波尼哥罗麾下的高级叛军指挥官贾亚库苏马一世与两名儿子及20名骑兵遭到伏击并阵亡。伏击者是一支规模更大的荷兰军队，成员包括爪哇人和米纳哈萨人，由爪哇军官拉登·恩加贝希·雷索迪维约率领；他后来被称为科克罗内戈罗一世。

en.s: The third siege of Szenttamás (now Srbobran, in the South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia) was an attempt of siege during the Hungarian War of Independence of 1848-1849, as a part of the Serb uprising of 1848–49, on 21 September 1848, carried out by the Hungarian Army under the command of General Lázár Mészáros against the Serbian fortified encampment in Szenttamás and Turia held by the Serb insurgents led by Captain Petar Biga.

zh.t: 圣塔马什第三次围城战
zh.s: 1848年9月21日，匈牙利军队在拉扎尔·梅萨罗什将军指挥下，试图围攻圣塔马什和图里亚的塞尔维亚防御营地。该营地由彼得·比加上尉率领的塞尔维亚起义军守卫。这场围城发生在1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争期间，也是1848—1849年塞尔维亚起义的一部分。圣塔马什现名塞尔博布兰，位于塞尔维亚伏伊伏丁那南巴奇卡区。

en.s: Colonial elections were held in South Australia on 20/21 September 1855. Only 16 of the 24 seats in the unicameral Legislative Council were popularly elected, the second occurrence of voting franchise in the colony. The 1851 election was the first of this type. The election resulted in violence on 20 September 1855 in Hindley Street between opponents and supporters of Anthony Forster, editor and part-owner of the South Australian Register and also one of the candidates for election.

zh.s: 南澳大利亚于1855年9月20日至21日举行殖民地选举。这是该殖民地第二次采用同类选举制度；此前1851年选举是首次。两院制改革前的单院立法委员会有24席，其中16席由选民投票产生。1855年9月20日，欣德利街发生暴力冲突，双方分别是安东尼·福斯特的反对者和支持者；福斯特既是《南澳大利亚纪事报》的编辑和共同所有者，也是候选人之一。
zh.n: 来源记载投票日为9月20日至21日；此条按信息框日期记录9月21日。

en.s: The Battle of Palikao (French: La bataille de Palikao; simplified Chinese: 八里桥之战; traditional Chinese: 八里橋之戰; pinyin: Bālǐqiáo zhī zhàn; lit. en.s: The Battle of Cixi or Battle of Tzeki (慈溪之戰) was an armed engagement in the Taiping Rebellion fought between the Ever Victorious Army of the Qing dynasty and forces of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom on September 21, 1862, at Cixi. The battle, which was won by the Ever Victorious Army, resulted in the mortal wounding of Frederick Townsend Ward, the American mercenary who founded and commanded the force.

zh.s: 慈溪战役又称浙溪战役，是太平天国运动期间的一场武装冲突，于1862年9月21日在慈溪爆发。交战双方是清朝常胜军和太平天国军队。常胜军获胜，其创立者兼指挥官、美国雇佣兵弗雷德里克·汤森·华尔在战斗中受了致命伤。

en.s: The 1911 Canadian federal election was held on September 21, 1911, to elect members of the House of Commons of Canada of the 12th Parliament of Canada. The central issue was Liberal support for a proposed agreement with the United States president William Howard Taft to lower tariffs. The Conservative Party denounced it with claims it would weaken ties with Britain, hurt the Canadian economy and Canadian identity, and lead to American annexation of Canada.

zh.s: 加拿大于1911年9月21日举行联邦选举，选出加拿大第12届议会的众议院议员。竞选焦点是自由党支持加拿大与美国总统威廉·霍华德·塔夫脱达成降低关税的协议。保守党批评该协议会削弱加拿大与英国的关系、损害加拿大经济和国家认同，并可能导致美国吞并加拿大。

en.s: The Battle of Doss Alto was a minor military engagement between the troops of Austria-Hungary and Italy on the Italian front of World War I on 21 September 1918. The battle took place on the Doss Alto di Nago hill in northern Italy. Italian regiments, composed of the members of Czechoslovak Legion in Italy, were able to defend their post on the hillside against Austro-Hungarians.

en.s: The Oppau explosion occurred on September 21, 1921, when a tower silo storing 4,500 tonnes of a mixture of ammonium sulfate and ammonium nitrate fertilizer exploded at a BASF plant in Oppau, now part of Ludwigshafen, Germany, killing 500–600 people and injuring about 2,000 more.

en.s: The EMLL 1st Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Empresa Mexicana de Lucha Libre (EMLL, later renamed Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre, CMLL) that took place on September 21, 1934 in Arena Modelo (In the same location Arena México was built years later), in Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the first anniversary of EMLL, which became the oldest still active professional wrestling promotion in the world by the 1990s. The Anniversary show is EMLL's biggest show of the year, their Super Bowl event, where a lot of storylines conclude and important matches are held.

zh.s: EMLL首届周年纪念大赛是墨西哥摔跤公司墨西哥自由摔跤企业（EMLL，后来更名为CMLL）于1934年9月21日在墨西哥城的模德洛竞技场举办的一场大型职业摔跤赛事；数年后，墨西哥竞技场在同一地点建成。该赛事纪念EMLL成立一周年。到20世纪90年代，EMLL已成为世界上仍在运营的历史最悠久的职业摔跤推广公司。周年纪念赛是EMLL每年最重要的赛事，就像他们的“超级碗”，通常会在其中结束许多剧情线并安排重要比赛。

en.t: J.R.R. Tolkien's The Hobbit is published for the first time. (September 22 is celebrated by some fans as Hobbit Day, however.)
en.s: The Hobbit, or There and Back Again is a children's fantasy novel by the English author J. R. R. Tolkien. It was published in 1937 to wide critical acclaim, being nominated for the Carnegie Medal and awarded a prize from the New York Herald Tribune for best juvenile fiction. It is recognized as a classic in children's literature and is one of the best-selling books of all time, with over 100 million copies sold.

zh.t: J·R·R·托尔金的《霍比特人》首次出版
zh.s: 《霍比特人，或去而复返》是英国作家J·R·R·托尔金创作的儿童奇幻小说，1937年出版后广受好评，曾获卡内基奖章提名，并获得《纽约先驱论坛报》最佳儿童小说奖。该书已成为儿童文学经典，也是史上最畅销的图书之一，销量超过1亿册。（部分读者将9月22日庆祝为“霍比特人日”。）

en.t: Romanian prime minister Armand Călinescu is assassinated by the Iron Guard
en.s: Armand Călinescu (4 June 1893 – 21 September 1939) was a Romanian economist and politician, who served as 39th Prime Minister from March 1939 until his assassination six months later. He was a staunch opponent of the fascist Iron Guard and may have been the real power behind the throne during the dictatorship of King Carol II.

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 21 September 1940. All 74 seats in the House of Representatives, and 19 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Coalition, consisting of the United Australia Party led by Prime Minister of Australia Robert Menzies and the Country Party led by Archie Cameron, defeated the opposition Australian Labor Party led by John Curtin. The Coalition won 36 seats, two short of a majority, but formed a government on 28 October 1940 with the support of both independent crossbenchers, Alexander Wilson and Arthur Coles.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1940年9月21日举行联邦选举。众议院全部74席以及参议院36席中的19席进行改选。由澳大利亚总理罗伯特·孟席斯领导的澳大利亚联合党，与阿奇·卡梅伦领导的乡村党组成的执政联盟击败了约翰·科廷领导的反对党澳大利亚工党。联盟赢得36席，距离过半还差两席，但在10月28日获得两名独立议员亚历山大·威尔逊和阿瑟·科尔斯支持后组建政府。

en.s: A total solar eclipse occurred at the Moon's ascending node of orbit on Sunday, September 21, 1941, with a magnitude of 1.0379. A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun, thereby totally or partly obscuring the image of the Sun for a viewer on Earth. A total solar eclipse occurs when the Moon's apparent diameter is larger than the Sun's, blocking all direct sunlight, turning day into darkness.

en.s: Battle of Porkuni (Estonian: Porkuni lahing) was the largest engagement between Estonians serving in the Red Army and Estonian pro-independence and Waffen-SS units. It took place on 21 September 1944 between Lake Porkuni and the Sauvälja village about seven kilometres northeast of the town of Tamsalu during the Leningrad Front's Tallinn Offensive Operation (17 September 1944 – 26 September 1944). The 249th Rifle Regiment of the 8th Estonian Rifle Corps had heavy machine guns and mortars and were supported by artillery and tanks. Soldiers of the Estonian Waffen Grenadier Division had only light arms and antitank weapons in the form of German panzerfausts.

zh.s: 波尔库尼战役（爱沙尼亚语：Porkuni lahing）是爱沙尼亚红军士兵与爱沙尼亚独立派及武装党卫军部队之间规模最大的一次交战。战斗于1944年9月21日在波尔库尼湖与绍瓦尔亚村之间进行，地点在塔姆萨卢镇东北约7公里处，属于列宁格勒方面军的塔林进攻行动（1944年9月17日至26日）。爱沙尼亚第8步兵军第249步兵团配备重机枪和迫击炮，并有炮兵和坦克支援。爱沙尼亚武装党卫军掷弹兵师的士兵只有轻武器和德国“铁拳”反坦克武器。

en.s: Hurricane Carrie was a deadly and long-lived Category 4 major hurricane which was the strongest tropical cyclone of the 1957 Atlantic hurricane season and one of the longest-lasting tropical cyclones in the North Atlantic basin. en.s: General elections were held in Singapore on 21 September 1963, five days after the merger with Malaysia. However, the result was a victory for the PAP, which won 37 of the 51 seats in the Legislative Assembly.

en.s: Mexicana de Aviación Flight 801 was a scheduled international flight from Chicago-O'Hare International Airport in Illinois bound for Mexico City International Airport, Mexico City. On September 21, 1969, the Boeing 727-100 crashed during its final approach to Mexico City International Airport. The aircraft broke apart upon impact, killing 27 of the 118 occupants on board. The cause of the crash was never determined.

en.s: The Jiji earthquake (Chinese: 集集大地震; pinyin: Jíjí dàdìzhèn), known locally as the 921 earthquake (九二一大地震; Jiǔ'èryī dàdìzhèn), was a 7.3 Ms or 7.6-7.7 Mw earthquake which occurred in Jiji, Nantou County, Taiwan on Tuesday, 21 September 1999 at 01:47:12.6 TST (Monday, 20 September 1999 at 17:47:12.6 UTC). 2,415 people were killed, 11,305 injured, and NT$300 billion (US$10 billion) worth of damage was done. It was the second-deadliest quake in recorded history in Taiwan, after the 1935 Shinchiku-Taichū earthquake. Rescue groups from around the world joined local relief workers and the ROC military in digging out survivors, clearing rubble, restoring essential services and distributing food and other aid to the more than 100,000 people made homeless by the quake.

zh.s: 集集地震（中文：集集大地震；拼音：Jíjí dàdìzhèn）当地也称“921大地震”（九二一大地震；拼音：Jiǔ'èryī dàdìzhèn），于1999年9月21日星期二台湾时间凌晨1时47分12.6秒发生在台湾南投县集集，震级为面波震级7.3级或矩震级7.6至7.7级；对应协调世界时为1999年9月20日星期一17时47分12.6秒。地震造成2,415人死亡、11,305人受伤，损失达新台币3,000亿元（约100亿美元）。这是台湾有记录以来第二致命的地震，仅次于1935年的新竹-台中地震。来自世界各地的救援队与当地救援人员及中华民国军方一同搜寻幸存者、清理瓦砾、恢复基本服务并分发食物和其他援助；地震造成逾10万人无家可归。

en.s: Provincial council elections were held in Sri Lanka on 21 September 2013 to elect 148 members to three of the nine provincial councils in the country. 4.4 million Sri Lankans were eligible to vote in the election. The United People's Freedom Alliance's domination of Sri Lankan elections continued as expected. It retained control of two provincial councils (Central and North Western) but the Tamil National Alliance won control of the first Northern Provincial Council.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于2013年9月21日举行省议会选举，选出全国9个省议会中的3个，共148席。440万斯里兰卡人有资格投票；其余6个省议会当时尚未到选举时间，因为最近一次选举分别在2009年或2012年举行。这是北部省25年来首次举行省议会选举。正如预期，统一人民自由联盟继续在斯里兰卡选举中占优势，保住中部省和西北省两个省议会；泰米尔民族联盟则赢得首届北部省议会。

en.s: On Saturday 21 September 2013, unidentified gunmen attacked Westgate shopping mall, an upscale mall in Nairobi, Kenya. The attack resulted in at least 67 deaths, and more than 175 people were reportedly wounded in the mass shooting. The extremist Islamic group al-Shabaab claimed responsibility for the incident, which it characterised as retribution for the Kenyan military's deployment in the group's home country of Somalia. Many media outlets also suspected the insurgent group's involvement in the attack based on earlier reprisal warnings it had issued in the wake of Operation Linda Nchi from 2011 to 2012.

en.s: Night of Champions (2014) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by WWE. It took place on September 21, 2014, at the Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, Tennessee, and was the eighth annual Night of Champions event. Eight matches took place at the event. Of the five championships contested, three changed hands. The main event saw John Cena defeat Brock Lesnar by disqualification (with Lesnar retaining his WWE World Heavyweight Championship), after it was interfered by Seth Rollins. The event had 48,000 buys (excluding WWE Network views). The previous year's drew 175,000 buys.

en.s: Senate elections for one-third of the Senate of the Czech Republic were held on 20–21 September 2024, with a second round on 27–28 September 2024. The first round was held alongside the regional elections. With all votes counted, ANO 2011 won eight of the 27 contested seats (the most of any single party), while candidates backed by the governing parties won 15 seats and the governing coalition retained a majority in the 81-seat Senate.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 捷克参议院三分之一席位于2024年9月20日至21日举行选举，第二轮投票定于9月27日至28日进行；首轮与地区选举同时举行。计票结束后，ANO 2011赢得27个待选席位中的8席，是单一政党中席位最多的。执政党支持的候选人赢得15席，执政联盟保住了81席参议院的多数。

en.s: The Swedish Church Assembly elections was held on 21 September 2025. All 251 seats in the General Synod of the Church of Sweden are up for election, as well as local governing bodies.
